findings.text: the eleven-file selection does not cover every module this wave landed: reckon/crew/serving_origin.py and its only test landed together at commit 9ea06319 (2026-09-21 14:50), inside the measured interval 1d2e70cc..825774198f7a637aa7aa6afc2d428390879fa45b, so a regression in that module leaves the report's "112 passed, 2 failed" unchanged and the gate cannot detect the omission from inside itself; re-run at the pinned revision, where both files are byte-identical to it by md5 (3b0f5ed5fc and 5d893d73bd), the omitted file is 23 passed exit 0, so the blind spot has not yet masked a wave regression. Four further test files added in the interval are also absent from the selection while exercising interval-changed modules: tests/test_evidence_from_report.py on reckon/evidence.py, tests/test_review_call_sites.py on reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_shared_landing_paths.py on reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_watcher_unit_restart.py on reckon/service.py. Twenty-one test files were added in the interval and the selection names nine of them.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 2e4c8c8e adds the evidence anchor and the figure, b2148230 appends the plan landing record, and neither commit is reachable from a branch because promotion is the coordinator's step, which is the contract a worker is held to.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names eleven files, one run at the head resolved when the node ran, base counts over the intersection with the exclusions listed by name, a pre-existing-or-added classification with added ids given explicitly, and an import-resolution check; report.md carries each clause and its cited logs corroborate the counts at both revisions.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asks that the tests covering everything this wave merged pass at the current head rather than at a revision seventeen merges old; report.md:7 pins head 825774198f7a637aa7aa6afc2d428390879fa45b and report.md:16-20 re-measures the predecessor's staleness defect, but the selection certified is not co-extensive with the wave, because reckon/crew/serving_origin.py landed at 9ea06319 inside the measured interval and its only test, tests/test_serving_origin.py, is not among the eleven.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; manifest.md:9-14 states 112 passed and 2 failed at head 825774198f7a637aa7aa6afc2d428390879fa45b against 25 passed and 2 failed at base 1d2e70cc over the same two files, and its tests field names four logs, all under the reports directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths and the two commits; git show --stat 2e4c8c8e b2148230 lists docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html, docs/figures/a-window-paces-the-lane/head-vs-base-gate.svg and docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html, and the report sits at the fourth declared path.

justifications.durability: report.md:5-9 binds the report to one revision so a later reader must re-run rather than re-quant, but nothing reddens if reckon/crew/serving_origin.py regresses, because its coverage sits in tests/test_serving_origin.py, outside the certified selection.
justifications.evidence: head-825774198f7a637aa7aa6afc2d428390879fa45b.log ends "2 failed, 112 passed" with the FAILED ids report.md:91-95 states, base-1d2e70cc.log ends "2 failed, 25 passed" on the same two ids, and superseded/ retains the refused pair with each run's own revision in its filename.
justifications.fit: report.md keeps the predecessor's section order and states the counts as a table at report.md:56-60, matching the idiom of reports/reckon/wave-integration/merged-head-report.md.
justifications.goal_fidelity: report.md:11 records one run at the pinned head and report.md:16-20 corrects the predecessor's stale revision, but report.md:70-85 shows the base comparison covers two files and the eleven-file selection omits tests/test_serving_origin.py, which landed with reckon/crew/serving_origin.py at commit 9ea06319.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits' diffstat carries exactly three repository paths, every one inside the four paths manifest.md declares, and no repository file outside them was written.
